answer: To stop Sybils, our network anchors identity in a growing vine of cryptographic attestation chains. Each node refracts its execution history through a zero-knowledge prism, proving authentic computation without data leakage. Registering swarms imposes an exponential staking bond scaling as $O(2^n)$, forcing exponential capital exhaustion. A malicious swarm blazes out like a short-lived comet, pricing out attackers superlinearly.
